rewrites.comment: Clean URLs for the static, crawlable pages. These MUST come before the SPA catch-all below, or every one of them would be answered with the app shell — which is what a crawler reads as 'this site has one page'. Static files (robots.txt, ads.txt, sitemap.xml, site.css) are served ahead of rewrites by Firebase, so they need no entry here.

The checkout page. MUST come before the SPA catch-all: without an entry here `**` answered /checkout with index.html, so the Upgrade button opened the chat app in a browser tab and no payment could ever be taken.

headers.comment: Report-Only first: observe violations without breaking esm.run / WASM / provider calls, then promote to Content-Security-Policy once clean.
